title.zh: 直接各向异性参数反演

summary: Bind caller-owned equilibrium and synthetic-diagnostic callables to a SciRel trial residual relation and bounded parameter optimizer, optionally choosing an initial point from Latin-hypercube samples.

identity.relation: caller forward equilibrium and diagnostic model plus observations to a fitted anisotropic parameter record
identity.direction: initial_params, bounds, observations, solver_config, caller ports and controls -> best trial, residual/chi2, optimizer and failure diagnostics
identity.definition: Copy initial_params, bounds and solver_config, require two caller callables and a method string, then bind SciRel observation residuals and one-trial evaluation into SciRel's parameter optimizer. Optional LHS samples choose the optimizer start. Each trial calls the supplied equilibrium solver with solver_config plus params, passes its output to the supplied diagnostic evaluator, and reduces matching predictions against observations. The graph annotates missing nonconvergence reasons after the optimizer returns.
identity.model: direct numerical inversion over caller-supplied anisotropic equilibrium and diagnostic physics; SciRel supplies orchestration and normalized residuals
identity.geometry: defined by caller solver_config and ports, conventionally an axisymmetric cylindrical R-Z equilibrium grid
identity.coordinates: solver_config.r_grid/z_grid are handed to diagnostic_evaluator as R/Z; optimizer vectors follow fit_keys or bounds insertion order
identity.boundary: SciRel does not impose an N6 solver boundary or select its closure; caller solver_config and equilibrium_solver must enforce their own grid, vacuum/Green, convergence and physical bounds. The optimizer receives fitted parameter bounds but this graph does not independently validate them.
assumptions: The caller-owned equilibrium_solver and diagnostic_evaluator form a compatible scientific forward model with the supplied observations.
A solver_config intended for SciRel free-boundary anisotropic Picard contains the required grid, vacuum field/flux, Green response and Picard controls; this wrapper only checks that it is a dict.
Diagnostic values, sigma and parameter units are mutually consistent; SciRel does not convert them.

inputs.name: initial_params
inputs.description: Full initial profile-parameter mapping, copied before optimization.
inputs.constraints: Must contain float-convertible fitted keys; nested solver defines parameter meaning.

inputs.name: bounds
inputs.description: Fitted-parameter interval mapping and default fit-key order.
inputs.constraints: Selected keys must exist; finite increasing intervals are required by LHS and meaningful SciPy fitting, although this wrapper does not check them.

inputs.name: observations
inputs.description: Diagnostic requests and measured values for the caller forward model and SciRel residual reducer.
inputs.units: mixed; each channel sigma shares its measurement units
inputs.shape: mapping with recognized flux_loops and/or thomson channels
inputs.constraints: At least one recognized prediction/observation match is needed for a nonpenalty trial; measurement points, when used by the caller, are [R,Z].

inputs.name: solver_config
inputs.description: Fixed caller equilibrium inputs excluding trial params, copied for each trial.
inputs.units: caller solver contract; when bound to SciRel free-boundary anisotropic Picard: R/Z m, psi=R A_phi Wb/rad, field T, g_psi Wb/rad/A
inputs.constraints: A successful trial requires r_grid/z_grid for diagnostic port; other required fields are specified by the caller solver. Wrapper only enforces dict type and does not convert units.

inputs.name: equilibrium_solver
inputs.description: Caller-owned equilibrium port invoked once for each trial with copied solver_config plus params.
inputs.constraints: Should return converged and failure_reason plus fields needed by the diagnostic. A nonconverged dict without reason is annotated by wrapper.

inputs.name: diagnostic_evaluator
inputs.description: Caller-owned synthetic diagnostic port invoked with equilibrium, R, Z and observations.
inputs.constraints: Must provide recognized matched predictions; the graph does not embed the synthesis-diagnostics TaskGraph.

inputs.name: method
inputs.constraints: Only least_squares or minimize selects SciPy; another string reaches optimizer fallback and is reported as failure.

inputs.name: fit_keys
inputs.description: Optional ordered subset of parameters to optimize.
inputs.constraints: Omitted uses bounds insertion order; selected keys must be in initial_params and bounds.

inputs.name: n_initial_samples
inputs.description: Optional number of LHS trial starts.
inputs.constraints: If non-null, SciRel LHS sampler is loaded and requires a positive integer after optimizer conversion.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Optional NumPy seed forwarded to LHS only.
inputs.constraints: No effect when LHS is omitted.

outputs.name: best_parameters
outputs.description: Full parameters of the lowest recorded chi2 trial.
outputs.constraints: Can come from LHS or SciPy evaluations.

outputs.name: chi2
outputs.description: Best normalized residual squared sum, or a trial penalty.
outputs.constraints: A caught nested evaluation exception records 1e24 for that trial; no graph-level chi2 threshold is imposed.

outputs.name: residual_vector
outputs.constraints: One element [1e12] for a penalty trial.

outputs.name: converged
outputs.description: SciPy optimizer success and best equilibrium converged, together.
outputs.constraints: Does not assert a small residual or scientific validity.

outputs.name: equilibrium
outputs.description: Best trial caller equilibrium, or null for a penalty-only best trial.
outputs.constraints: May be nonconverged when the optimizer result is false.

outputs.name: evaluation_log
outputs.description: Ordered LHS then optimizer trial summaries.
outputs.constraints: Each entry records params, chi2, failure_reason and source.

outputs.name: failure_reason
outputs.description: Optimizer exception reason or wrapper-supplied equilibrium/optimizer nonconvergence reason.
outputs.constraints: If converged=False and optimizer supplied no reason, wrapper supplies an equilibrium reason or 'parameter optimizer did not converge'.

outputs.name: optimizer_summary
outputs.description: Serializable SciPy method/success/status/message/nfev fields or null after fallback.
outputs.constraints: No full SciPy result object is returned.

preconditions: The caller provides scientifically compatible equilibrium and diagnostic implementations and aligned observations.
Selected fit parameters and bounds are meaningful to the caller model and acceptable to the chosen SciPy optimizer.
supported: Direct one-stage bounded fitting with optional LHS initialization against matched flux-loop/Thomson-like observations.
Caller-owned N6-like equilibrium and N9-like diagnostic ports with an explicit failure/penalty record.
excluded: A built-in equilibrium solver, pressure closure, synthetic diagnostic or automatic instrument physics.
Global optimality, physical correctness, uncertain parameter inference or a guarantee that a successful optimizer has small residual.
Automatic source-model selection or independent validation of solver_config's physical fields.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: The wrapper raises ValueError for non-dict required mappings, absent/noncallable caller ports, missing method or non-string method. Selected-key and bound errors may arise from optimizer/LHS; recognized observation mismatches inside a trial become penalty records rather than direct exceptions.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Nested trial exceptions become one-element 1e12 residual and chi2=1e24. The optimizer catches SciPy selection/execution errors and makes a fallback trial; errors before or during that fallback propagate. No retry of caller solver is hidden.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Returns converged=False with best retained record when SciPy or best equilibrium is nonconverged; wrapper fills a missing failure_reason from equilibrium or the generic optimizer message.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Caught trial and optimizer failures return explicit best/penalty records and logs; uncaught setup/fallback errors return no graph mapping.

provenance.lineage_summary: Maintained SciRel composition mapped to a saved Pleiades L1 direct-inversion TaskGraph and direct graph tests. Historical candidate/admission labels are development provenance, not expert recognition of this version.
source_kinds: saved L1 TaskGraph contract and implementation
maintained SciRel public graph regression tests

example.description: A simple injected forward model and diagnostic fit a scalar pressure-like parameter; this illustrates port wiring, not physical equilibrium validity.
example.expected: The injected synthetic model recovers p0 near 4, with a small residual and converged optimizer/best-equilibrium flags.

scope: Explicit caller solver/diagnostic ports and public dependency resolver.

Synthetic one-parameter recovery with zero-G source fixture, a simple public callable example, and a nonzero-Green SciRel equilibrium in the isotropic-pressure limit with explicit circular-loop flux conversion.
Optional LHS determinism, invalid method/bounds and nested port penalty behavior.
Missing ports/method and nonconverged equilibrium reason handling.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct graph and leaf tests cover selected synthetic fitting, port binding, a nonzero-Green SciRel equilibrium composition in the isotropic-pressure limit with an explicit 2π psi-to-loop-flux diagnostic, and failure paths; they do not certify a physical anisotropic equilibrium, real diagnostic calibration, global optimum or expert recognition.
known_limitations: The nonzero-Green composition test uses an isotropic-pressure limit and an injected circular-loop flux sampler, not a calibrated diagnostic or general anisotropic equilibrium.

The equilibrium-synthesis-diagnostics graph's historical flux_loops key returns caller psi point samples, not automatically 2π psi; physical Wb loop observations require an explicit compatible diagnostic port when the equilibrium provides Wb/rad psi.
A fitted result depends on caller-owned equilibrium and diagnostic implementations, not embedded SciRel N6/N9 physics.
The optimizer's iteration policy is inside its SciPy Operator, not a TaskGraph feedback edge or a user-supplied graph-level iteration bound.
Public distribution licensing and SciRel expert recognition remain pending.

nodes.description: Require and retain caller equilibrium_solver; wrap a nonconverged mapping without a reason with the standard equilibrium reason.
Require and retain caller diagnostic_evaluator callable.
Bind the SciRel flux-first normalized residual callable for deferred trials.
Partially bind observations, copied solver configuration and three callable ports to the SciRel trial Operator; it is evaluated by the optimizer, not pre-executed here.
Bind the SciRel sampler callable only when n_initial_samples is present; optimizer executes it with bounds, count, seed and fit keys.
Run LHS-first optional initialization and SciPy parameter evaluations through the bound trial callable; retain best record and status.
If optimizer result is nonconverged and lacks a reason, derive the available equilibrium reason or the generic optimizer reason; preserve all other fields.

edges.transform: Validate callable and wrap missing nonconvergence reason.
Copy mapping once and each trial payload separately.
Add wrapper reason only if nonconverged and absent.

execution.ordering: Validate required dict inputs and both caller callables plus method; bind residual and trial callables; if n_initial_samples is supplied bind LHS; optimizer evaluates LHS candidates first, then SciPy trials, then wrapper annotates missing nonconvergence reason.
branches: No LHS callable is passed when n_initial_samples is null.
When LHS is present, its lowest recorded chi2 sample becomes the SciPy start.
Nested trial exceptions become penalty records; caught optimizer exceptions trigger one fallback trial.
A nonconverged result with no reason receives the equilibrium or generic optimizer reason.
execution.state_ownership: The wrapper copies top-level initial_params, bounds and solver_config; each trial owns a new parameter mapping and solver payload. Caller callables own their forward-model state; the optimizer owns its evaluation log and SciPy search state.
execution.failure_propagation: Required-input and port validation errors propagate; nested trial errors are penalized; pre-SciPy LHS and fallback failures propagate. The graph does not return partial output on an uncaught error.
